extraction.notes: Keyword screen of the whole report: interoperab, MConnect, e-government, digital service, online service, EVO, CUPS, e-service, automat, data exchange, ex officio, digitalis. MConnect is not named anywhere in the report. Left out as other sectors or not about the two issues: customs, tax, justice, health and financial sector systems; the Programme for the Implementation of the Digital Transformation Strategy 2025-2027 (page 76), which names no portal or platform measure; eIDAS alignment (page 76). Text-file page numbers are printed page numbers plus one. Only sections on the named issues were extracted, as the run 1b brief requires. Second pass by checker-I: see review/RUN-2026-01/run1b/second_pass/MDA-EU-2025-001.csv.
